verses.ar:
يَا شَفِيعَ الْوَرَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
يَا نَبِيَّ الْهُدَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
خَاتِمَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
سَيِّدَ الْأَصْفِيَاءِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Yā shafīʿa-l-warā salāmun ʿalayk
Yā nabiyya-l-hudā salāmun ʿalayk
Khātima-l-anbiyāʾ salāmun ʿalayk
Sayyida-l-aṣfiyāʾ salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: O intercessor of mankind, peace be upon you; O prophet of guidance, peace be upon you; seal of the prophets, peace be upon you; master of the chosen ones, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
أَحْمَدُ لَيْسَ مِثْلُكَ أَحَدْ
مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
وَاجِبٌ حُبُّكَ عَلَى الْمَخْلُوقْ
يَا حَبِيبَ الْعُلَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Aḥmadu laysa mithluka aḥad
Marḥaban marḥaban salāmun ʿalayk
Wājibun ḥubbuka ʿala-l-makhlūq
Yā ḥabība-l-ʿulā salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: Ahmad, none is like you — welcome, welcome, peace be upon you; love for you is owed by every creature, O beloved of the Most High, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
أَعْظَمُ الْخَلْقِ أَشْرَفُ الشُّرَفَاءِ
أَفْضَلُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
مَهْبَطُ الْوَحْيِ مَنْزِلُ الْقُرْآنِ
صَاحِبُ الِاهْتِدَاءِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Aʿẓamu-l-khalqi ashrafu-sh-shurafāʾ
Afḍalu-l-anbiyāʾ salāmun ʿalayk
Mahbaṭu-l-waḥyi manzilu-l-Qurʾān
Ṣāḥibu-l-ihtidāʾ salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: Greatest of creation, most honoured of the honoured, most excellent of the prophets, peace be upon you; the place where revelation descended, the home of the Qur'an, master of guidance, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
اِشْفَعْ لِي يَا حَبِيبِي يَوْمَ الْجَزَاءِ
أَنْتَ شَافِعُنَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا ظُلْمَةَ الظُّلَمَاءِ
أَنْتَ بَدْرُ الدُّجَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Ishfaʿ lī yā ḥabībī yawma-l-jazāʾ
Anta shāfiʿunā salāmun ʿalayk
Kashafta ʿannā ẓulmata-ẓ-ẓulamāʾ
Anta badru-d-dujā salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: Intercede for me, O my beloved, on the Day of Recompense — you are our intercessor, peace be upon you; you lifted from us the darkness of every darkness, you are the full moon of the night, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
طَلَعَتْ مِنْكَ كَوْكَبُ الْعِرْفَانِ
أَنْتَ شَمْسُ الضُّحَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
لَيْلَةَ الْإِسْرَاءِ قَالَتِ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ
مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Ṭalaʿat minka kawkabu-l-ʿirfān
Anta shamsu-ḍ-ḍuḥā salāmun ʿalayk
Laylata-l-isrāʾi qālati-l-anbiyāʾ
Marḥaban marḥaban salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: From you rose the star of gnosis — you are the sun of forenoon, peace be upon you; on the Night Journey the prophets themselves said: welcome, welcome, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
مَقْصُودِي يَا حَبِيبِي لَيْسَ سِوَاكْ
أَنْتَ مَقْصُودُنَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
إِنَّكَ مَقْصَدِي وَمَلْجَئِي
إِنَّكَ مُدَّعَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Maqṣūdī yā ḥabībī laysa siwāk
Anta maqṣūdunā salāmun ʿalayk
Innaka maqṣadī wa maljaʾī
Innaka mudda ʿā salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: My aim, O my beloved, is none but you — you are our aim, peace be upon you; you are my goal and my refuge, you are the one I call upon, peace be upon you.

verses.ar:
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى
أَفْضَلُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
هَذَا أَوَّلُ غُلَامِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي
مِنْهُمْ يَا مُصْطَفَى سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ
verses.tr:
Ṣalawātu-llāhi ʿala-l-Muṣṭafā
Afḍalu-l-anbiyāʾ salāmun ʿalayk
Hādhā awwalu ghulāmika yā sayyidī
Minhum yā Muṣṭafā salāmun ʿalayk
verses.en: The blessings of Allah be upon the Chosen One, most excellent of the prophets, peace be upon you; this is the first of your servants, O my master — one of them, O Chosen One, peace be upon you.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon him and his family.
